json.title: Establish technology governance framework
json.description: The Board must create a governance framework to ensure technology aligns with and supports the organization's goals.
json.full_text: The Board of Directors of the FI(s) are responsible to establish a comprehensive enterprise technology governance framework which defines the leadership, organizational structures and processes to ensure that the FI(s) technology sustains and extends the enterprises strategies and objectives.
json.ai_notes: Clear directive for the Board to establish a governance framework.

json.title: Monitor compliance to policies and performance against plans
json.description: Regularly check adherence to policies and track performance against established plans.
json.full_text: Monitor compliance to policies and performance against the plans.
json.ai_notes: Monitoring is a critical component of governance frameworks.

json.title: Align IT and business strategies
json.description: Ensure IT strategies are aligned with business strategies, focusing on value delivery, risk, and resource management.
json.full_text: The basic principles of strategic alignment of IT and the business, value delivery to businesses, risk management, resource management (including project management) and performance management shall form the basis of this technology governance framework.
json.ai_notes: Alignment is explicitly stated as a foundational principle.

json.title: Align technology governance framework with corporate governance
json.description: Ensure the technology governance framework is integrated with the overall corporate governance framework.
json.full_text: Technology governance framework shall be closely aligned with FI(s)s corporate governance framework and shall cover, among other things, policies and procedures to provide oversight and transparency in the use of technology.
json.ai_notes: Alignment with corporate governance is explicitly required.

json.title: Adopt international standards for technology governance
json.description: Adopt international standards and best practices to enhance technology governance.
json.full_text: FI(s) are encouraged to adopt relevant aspects of international standards/best practices for effective and efficient enterprise technology governance.
json.ai_notes: Encouragement to adopt standards is not mandatory but recommended.

json.title: Approve IT Strategy
json.description: The Board must formally approve the IT Strategy, ensuring it aligns with organizational goals and includes key operational elements.
json.full_text: The BoD shall approve 'IT Strategy' covering overall design and plan of its operational framework including its vision and mission, stakeholders, business, workflow and processes, data processing, system access, adoption of best-in-class information security systems, practices and availability of IT resources.
json.ai_notes: Explicit requirement for Board approval of IT Strategy.

json.title: Identify constraints and enablers for IT objectives
json.description: Identify factors that may hinder or support the achievement of IT objectives.
json.full_text: The FI(s) shall identify any organizational/environmental/cultural constraints and enablers to achieve the strategic IT objectives.
json.ai_notes: Identification of constraints and enablers is implied as part of strategic planning.

json.title: Approve Digital Strategy for customer-focused products
json.description: The board must formally approve a strategy that prioritizes the development of digital products and services tailored to customer needs.
json.full_text: The board shall approve a 'Digital Strategy' covering, at least the following objectives: Development of customer-focused digital products and services.
json.ai_notes: Clear directive requiring board approval of a digital strategy.

json.title: Approve Digital Strategy for end-to-end digitization
json.description: The board must approve a strategy that ensures complete digitization of processes to enhance delivery of digital products and services.
json.full_text: The board shall approve a 'Digital Strategy' covering, at least the following objectives: End-to-end digitization of processes for delivery of digital products and services.
json.ai_notes: Directive clearly mandates board approval of digitization strategy.

json.title: Approve Digital Strategy for interoperability of delivery channels
json.description: The board must approve a strategy that ensures seamless interoperability across various delivery channels.
json.full_text: The board shall approve a 'Digital Strategy' covering, at least the following objectives: Interoperability of delivery channels.
json.ai_notes: Directive explicitly requires board approval of interoperability strategy.

json.title: BoD to review and approve IT governance framework
json.description: The board must review and formally approve an IT governance framework to align technology use with corporate goals.
json.full_text: The Board of Directors (BoD) sets the tone and direction for an FI(s) use of technology. BoD, at minimum, shall perform the following: Review and approve an IT governance framework to ensure that organization’s IT supports and enables the achievement of the corporate strategies and objectives.
json.ai_notes: Directive clearly mandates board review and approval of IT governance framework.

json.title: BoD to review and approve IT and Digital Strategies
json.description: The board must review and approve IT and digital strategies aligned with the bank's business strategy, ensuring regular updates.
json.full_text: Review and approve 'IT Strategy' and 'Digital Strategy' in line with the business strategy of the bank and monitor & update the same on regular basis keeping in view potential opportunities and threats.
json.ai_notes: Directive explicitly requires board review and approval of IT and digital strategies.

json.title: Establish IT organization structure
json.description: The organization must establish a structured IT function aligned with the IT governance framework to ensure efficiency and effectiveness.
json.full_text: Establish an efficient and effective IT organization structure in line with the IT governance framework.
json.ai_notes: Directive clearly mandates establishment of IT organization structure.

json.title: Integrate technology risks with enterprise risk management
json.description: Technology risks must be incorporated into the enterprise risk management framework to ensure robust protection of information assets.
json.full_text: Ensure that technology risks are integrated with the enterprise risk management function to achieve security, reliability, resiliency, interoperability and recoverability of data/information and information assets.
json.ai_notes: Directive clearly mandates integration of technology risks into enterprise risk management.

json.title: Approve and review technology-related policies
json.description: The board must approve and periodically review all technology-related policies to ensure alignment with technological and regulatory changes.
json.full_text: Approve all technology-related policies and review the same periodically in light of major technological/regulatory developments at least after every three (03) years.
json.ai_notes: Directive explicitly requires board approval and review of technology-related policies.

json.title: Maintain independent technology audit function
json.description: The organization must maintain an independent technology audit function that matches the complexity of its technology risk profile.
json.full_text: Ensure maintenance of an independent and effective technology audit function commensurate with the complexity of FI(s) technology risk profile.
json.ai_notes: Directive clearly mandates maintenance of an independent technology audit function.

json.title: Address resource gaps in technology
json.description: The organization must address identified resource gaps in technology, including personnel, processes, and tools, in a timely manner.
json.full_text: Ensure that resource gaps (people, process & technology) identified by the management are adequately and timely fulfilled.
json.ai_notes: Directive clearly mandates addressing resource gaps in technology.

json.title: Ensure up-to-date skills for technology governance
json.description: Ensure that personnel involved in technology governance and related areas have the necessary and current skills to perform their roles effectively.
json.full_text: Ensure that the skills required for technology governance, service delivery, information security and risk management are sufficient and up-to-date.
json.ai_notes: Clear requirement to ensure skills are sufficient and current.

json.title: Approve and monitor major technology projects
json.description: Ensure that the board approves and monitors major technology projects, including defining criteria for what constitutes a major project.
json.full_text: Approve and receive periodic updates on major technology-related projects that may have significant impact on FI(s)’ operations, earnings or capital. Further, the board shall also define the criteria for major projects.
json.ai_notes: Explicit requirement for board approval and monitoring.

json.title: Implement IT and Digital Strategy approved by BoD
json.description: Ensure that the IT and Digital Strategies approved by the Board of Directors are implemented effectively.
json.full_text: Implement “IT strategy” and “Digital Strategy” approved by the BoD.
json.ai_notes: Clear directive to implement board-approved strategies.

json.title: Monitor and assess technology governance program
json.description: Regularly monitor and evaluate the effectiveness of the technology governance program in supporting business objectives.
json.full_text: Monitor implementation of the technology governance program and assess its effectiveness on business lines and processes.
json.ai_notes: Explicit requirement to monitor and assess the program.

json.title: Implement effective information security awareness program
json.description: Establish and maintain an organization-wide program to raise awareness about information security risks and best practices.
json.full_text: Ensure that an effective information security awareness program is implemented throughout the organization.
json.ai_notes: Clear requirement for an awareness program.

json.title: Inform BoD on cyber security developments and threats
json.description: Provide regular updates to the Board of Directors on cybersecurity developments, including action plans, implementation progress, and major threats.
json.full_text: Periodically inform BoD on the latest developments on cyber security action plan, its implementation status, and a summary report on major threats and attacks faced by the institution and their estimated impact on its operations.
json.ai_notes: Explicit requirement for periodic updates to the Board.

json.title: Ensure documented SOPs are in place and followed
json.description: Ensure that all technology operations have documented SOPs that are consistently followed.
json.full_text: Ensure that the documented Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) are in place and are effectively followed in letter and spirit in all areas of technology operations.
json.ai_notes: Clear requirement for documented and followed SOPs.

json.title: Ensure IT personnel capacity building
json.description: Provide training and development opportunities to IT personnel to enhance their skills and support operational excellence.
json.full_text: Ensure capacity building of the IT personnel to achieve desired service delivery and operational excellence.
json.ai_notes: Clear requirement for IT personnel capacity building.

json.title: Select technology solutions meeting strategic requirements
json.description: Ensure that technology solutions are selected based on their ability to meet strategic goals while optimizing resources.
json.full_text: Select technology solutions that can meet strategic requirements within optimum resources.
json.ai_notes: Implicit requirement to align technology selection with strategy.

json.title: Monitor completion of technology projects
json.description: This control ensures that technology projects are tracked to completion with sufficient resources to avoid delays or failures.
json.full_text: Ensure that an effective mechanism is in place to monitor completion of technology projects and adequate resources are available to complete these projects.

json.title: Manage risks in technology outsourcing arrangements
json.description: This control ensures that risks from outsourcing technology services, including cloud providers, are effectively managed.
json.full_text: Identify, measure, monitor, and control the risks associated with technology-related outsourcing arrangements including cloud services.

json.title: Develop and maintain Disaster Recovery and BCP
json.description: This control ensures that disaster recovery and business continuity plans are created, tested, and maintained to minimize disruptions.
json.full_text: Develop, conduct and maintain Disaster Recovery & Business Continuity Plans and document their testing in line with the policy approved by the board.

json.title: Identify and address resource gaps
json.description: This control ensures that gaps in resources such as personnel, processes, or technology are identified and addressed promptly.
json.full_text: Identify resources gap (people, process & technology) and take appropriate steps to fill the gaps.

json.title: Establish sound governance framework for cyber security
json.description: Ensure the organization has a structured governance framework with leadership oversight to manage cyber security effectively across all levels.
json.full_text: A sound governance framework with strong leadership is essential for effective enterprise-wide cyber security management.

json.title: Develop and implement cyber security awareness program
json.description: Create and execute a program to educate employees and stakeholders about cyber security risks and best practices.
json.full_text: Developing and implementing a robust cyber security awareness program and ensuring that end-users are aware of the importance of protecting sensitive information and the risks of mishandling information.

json.title: Establish written procedures for vendor access to sensitive data
json.description: Define and document procedures for granting vendors access to sensitive data and systems securely.
json.full_text: Establish written procedures to allow access to the vendors on sensitive data/information and systems.

json.title: Implement automated solutions to monitor cyber attacks
json.description: Deploy tools and systems to continuously monitor and detect cyber attacks in real-time.
json.full_text: Implement automated solutions to monitor and proactively track all types of cyber attacks.

json.title: Incorporate consistent approach for selecting security controls
json.description: Adopt a standardized methodology for identifying and implementing security controls across systems.
json.full_text: Incorporate a consistent and comparable approach for selecting and specifying security controls for computer systems.

json.title: Develop and implement internal assessment methods for security controls
json.description: Create procedures to regularly assess the effectiveness of implemented security controls.
json.full_text: Develop and implement internal assessment methods/procedures for determining security control effectiveness.

json.title: Deploy multi-layer security model
json.description: Implement a layered security approach to protect systems and data using multiple defensive mechanisms.
json.full_text: Deploy multi-layer security model including firewalls, secure sign-on, dual authentication with triangulation of access and real-time security event monitoring.

json.title: Submit significant incidents to IT Steering Committee
json.description: Ensure significant incidents are reported to the IT Steering Committee for review and decision-making.
json.full_text: Significant incidents are submitted for review to the IT Steering Committee on a regular basis.

json.title: Report cyber security breaches to BPRD within 48 hours
json.description: Ensure all significant cyber security breaches are reported to the BPRD within 48 hours of detection.
json.full_text: The FI(s) shall report to Banking Policy & Regulation Department (BPRD), SBP within forty-eight (48) hours after the incident all established information/cyber security breaches and related incidents involving financial loss, stealing of confidential data and major disruption in the banking system or communication channel.

json.title: Use testing results to improve information security
json.description: Leverage findings from security testing to enhance the organization's information and cyber security posture.
json.full_text: The results of the testing program shall be used by the FI(s) to support the improvement in their Information/cyber security.

json.title: Perform vulnerability assessments
json.description: Regularly assess systems and processes to identify security vulnerabilities and risks.
json.full_text: FI(s) shall perform vulnerability assessments to identify and assess security vulnerabilities in their systems and processes.

json.title: Conduct scenario-based testing for response and recovery plans
json.description: Test response, resumption, and recovery plans using realistic scenarios to ensure effectiveness during incidents.
json.full_text: FI(s) response, resumption and recovery plans shall be subject to periodic review and testing.

json.title: Carry out periodic penetration tests
json.description: Perform penetration tests regularly to identify vulnerabilities in systems, networks, and processes.
json.full_text: FI(s) shall carry out periodic penetration tests to identify vulnerabilities that may affect their systems, networks, people or processes.

json.title: Ensure independent QA function for in-house developments
json.description: Establish an independent QA function to review in-house developments for vulnerabilities and risks.
json.full_text: FI(s) shall ensure that a proper and independent QA function exists and operates to testify in-house developments for any vulnerability that may pose a risk.

json.title: Establish project management standards
json.description: Ensure that formal project management standards are established to guide project planning, execution, and oversight, including risk management and approval processes.
json.full_text: FI(s) shall ensure that project management standards are in place to address issues such as need assessment, risk management procedures and project approval authorities.

json.title: Include functional, security, and control features in system standards
json.description: Ensure system standards define functional capabilities, security measures, and automated controls for applications.
json.full_text: System control standards shall include an application's functional, security, and automated control features.

json.title: Define quality assurance standards
json.description: Establish quality assurance standards to validate project assumptions, ensure compliance with standards, and test product performance.
json.full_text: Quality assurance standards shall address issues such as validation of project assumptions, adherence to project standards and testing of a product's performance.

json.title: Conduct security and vulnerability assessments of software modules
json.description: Perform regular security and vulnerability assessments to identify and mitigate risks in software modules.
json.full_text: Security and vulnerability assessment of software modules shall be conducted.

json.title: Establish escrow arrangements for vendor-developed core applications
json.description: Ensure escrow agreements are in place for vendor-developed applications where source code is not provided.
json.full_text: An escrow arrangement shall exist in cases where core applications are developed by vendors but the source codes were not released to the FI(s).

json.title: Formulate RFP and BRD for major IT acquisitions
json.description: Develop and maintain policies for creating RFPs and BRDs to guide major IT acquisitions.
json.full_text: FI(s) shall develop/update technology procurement policy covering formulation of RFP and Business Requirement Document (BRD).

json.title: Define roles and responsibilities for procurement stakeholders
json.description: Clearly define roles and responsibilities for all stakeholders involved in the procurement process.
json.full_text: FI(s) shall develop/update technology procurement policy covering roles and responsibilities of relevant stakeholders.

json.title: Establish approval matrix for RFP and BRD
json.description: Define an approval matrix for RFPs and BRDs to ensure proper authorization and accountability.
json.full_text: FI(s) shall develop/update technology procurement policy covering approval matrix of RFP and BRD.

json.title: Include vendor and asset selection criteria in procurement policy
json.description: Ensure procurement policy includes detailed criteria for selecting vendors and technology assets, along with acquisition and monitoring processes.
json.full_text: The technology procurement policy shall include types of technology assets for both hardware & software, types of vendors for hardware & software, selection criteria for vendors, acquisition process, payment procedures & monitoring, delivery assurance & verification process, technical vetting requirement and need assessment.

json.title: Identify and record functional, operational, and regulatory requirements in RFP/ITT
json.description: Ensure RFPs and ITTs include all functional, operational, and regulatory requirements to guide vendor responses.
json.full_text: FI(s) shall ensure that functional, operational and regulatory requirements are identified and recorded in Request-For-Proposals (RFP) or Invitations-To-Tender (ITT) in the bid solicitation process.

json.title: Review RFP and BRD for alignment with IT strategy and business objectives
json.description: Ensure that the RFP and BRD documents for new technology acquisitions align with the organization's IT strategy, business goals, and emerging technology trends.
json.full_text: The RFP and BRD for any new technology acquisition shall be reviewed to ascertain comprehensiveness of the documents, their alignment with IT strategy & business objectives and technical alignments with emerging trends and technologies.
json.ai_notes: Clear directive to review RFP and BRD for alignment.

json.title: Obtain expert consultancy for procurement process if necessary
json.description: Engage expert consultants for procurement processes when needed, ensuring reasons and justifications are documented.
json.full_text: FI(s) may obtain expert consultancy/advisory services for the formulation of RFP/BRD/Procurement process, where it deems necessary, provided they record reasons and rationale for the same.
json.ai_notes: Optional control; evidence requirements focus on documentation of rationale.

json.title: Conduct system selection analysis to meet user and business requirements
json.description: Perform a detailed analysis to ensure selected systems meet user needs, business goals, and compliance requirements.
json.full_text: FI(s) shall conduct a system (hardware, software and services) selection analysis to ensure that user and business requirements are met, expected service levels are properly achieved as per contract agreements and all applicable legal/regulatory requirements are complied with.
json.ai_notes: Mandatory control with clear requirements for analysis and compliance.

json.title: Ensure transparent and competitive procurement processes
json.description: Ensure that major procurements are conducted through a transparent and competitive process to promote fairness and accountability.
json.full_text: FI(s) shall undergo a transparent and competitive process of acquisitions in major procurements.
json.ai_notes: Clear directive for transparent procurement processes.

json.title: Manage procurement process by independent unit and IT Steering Committee
json.description: Ensure that an independent unit and the IT Steering Committee oversee procurement processes to maintain governance and accountability.
json.full_text: The procurement process shall be managed by an independent unit and governed by IT Steering Committee for different scope/level/size of procurements.
json.ai_notes: Mandatory control with clear governance requirements.

json.title: Form a forum to monitor technology procurement processes
json.description: Establish a forum or structure to oversee and monitor technology procurement processes.
json.full_text: FI(s) shall form an appropriate forum/structure to monitor the process of technology-related procurements.
json.ai_notes: Mandatory control with clear monitoring requirements.

json.title: Ensure vendor delivery aligns with contract terms
json.description: Verify that vendors deliver products and services in accordance with the agreed contract terms and conditions.
json.full_text: FI(s) shall also ensure that vendors deliver hardware/software as per terms and conditions set in the contract/agreement.
json.ai_notes: Mandatory control with clear focus on vendor compliance.

json.title: Promote only tested and approved systems to production
json.description: Ensure that only systems that have been thoroughly tested and approved are deployed to the production environment.
json.full_text: FI(s) shall ensure that only properly tested and approved systems are promoted to the production environment.
json.ai_notes: Mandatory control with clear focus on system testing and approval.

json.title: Identify and address contingency scenarios
json.description: Identify potential contingency scenarios and implement measures to address them, including system faults, hardware failures, and datacenter outages.
json.full_text: Identify and address various types of contingency scenarios, which may be caused by system faults, hardware malfunction, operating errors or security incidents and total incapacitation of the primary Datacenter.
json.ai_notes: Mandatory control with clear focus on contingency planning.

json.title: Evaluate and update recovery plan annually
json.description: Review and update the recovery plan and incident response procedures annually or when significant changes occur.
json.full_text: Evaluate the recovery plan and incident response procedures at least annually and update them as and when changes to business operations, systems and networks occur.
json.ai_notes: Mandatory control with clear focus on annual review and updates.

json.title: Implement replication and rapid recovery capabilities
json.description: Ensure systems and applications have mechanisms for replication and quick recovery to minimize downtime during disruptions.
json.full_text: Implement replication, rapid backup and recovery capabilities at the individual system or application cluster level.

json.title: Consider interdependencies in recovery planning
json.description: Account for how critical systems depend on each other when creating recovery plans and testing contingencies.
json.full_text: Consider inter-dependencies between critical systems in drawing up its recovery plan and conducting contingency tests.
json.ai_notes: Interdependencies are implied but not explicitly detailed in the control.

json.title: Select DR specifications based on BIA
json.description: Use the results of the Business Impact Analysis (BIA) to determine disaster recovery specifications that address threats and meet recovery goals.
json.full_text: The selection of DR specifications shall be made according to the BIA to address the identified threats and to meet the recovery objectives.

json.title: Adopt approved and rehearsed recovery measures
json.description: Ensure recovery measures are formally approved, tested, and rehearsed to confirm their effectiveness.
json.full_text: Adopt approved, tested and rehearsed recovery measures.

json.title: Test recovery requirements annually
json.description: Conduct annual tests to ensure recovery requirements are effective and staff can execute recovery procedures.
json.full_text: Test and validate, at least annually, the effectiveness of recovery requirements and the ability of staff to execute the necessary emergency and recovery procedures.

json.title: Cover various scenarios in DR tests
json.description: Include diverse scenarios in disaster recovery tests, such as full site shutdowns and individual component failures.
json.full_text: Cover various scenarios in disaster recovery tests including total shutdown/complete switchover of the primary site as well as component failure at the individual system or application cluster level.

json.title: Test recovery dependencies between systems
json.description: Verify that recovery dependencies between systems are tested to ensure seamless recovery.
json.full_text: Test the recovery dependencies between systems.

json.title: Conduct BCP/DR drills with third parties annually
json.description: Conduct annual BCP/DR drills involving third parties to ensure coordinated recovery efforts.
json.full_text: BCP/DR drills planned with third parties, if any, shall be performed annually.

json.title: Include all aspects in BCP testing
json.description: Ensure BCP tests cover all organizational aspects, including people, processes, and technology, and that staff are familiar with the plans.
json.full_text: Testing of BCP shall include all aspects and constituents of a bank i.e. people, processes and resources (including technology). BCP tests shall ensure that all members of the recovery team and relevant staff are aware of the plans.

json.title: Involve business users in DR test design
json.description: Engage business users in designing and executing test cases to ensure recovered systems meet functional requirements.
json.full_text: Involve business users in the design and execution of comprehensive test cases to verify that recovered systems function properly.

json.title: Participate in service provider DR tests
json.description: Ensure active participation in disaster recovery tests conducted by service providers, including offshore systems, to validate recovery capabilities.
json.full_text: Participate in disaster recovery tests that are conducted by its service provider(s), including those systems, which are located offshore.
json.ai_notes: Participation is explicitly required, but evidence specifics are inferred.

json.title: Involve business heads in DR-BCP test sign-off
json.description: Ensure business group/unit heads review and approve the results of DR-BCP drills to confirm alignment with business needs.
json.full_text: Involve the respective business group heads/unit heads while signing-off test results of DR-BCP drills.
json.ai_notes: Sign-off requirement is explicit, but evidence specifics are inferred.

json.title: Define recovery priorities and objectives
json.description: Establish clear recovery priorities and objectives, including RTO and RPO, to guide disaster recovery efforts.
json.full_text: Define system recovery, business resumption priorities and establish specific recovery objectives including Recovery Time Objectives (RTO) and Recovery Point Objective (RPO) for IT systems and applications.
json.ai_notes: Clear SHALL requirement for defining recovery objectives.

json.title: Establish geographically separated recovery site
json.description: Set up a recovery site in a different geographic location to ensure business continuity during primary site disruptions.
json.full_text: Establish a recovery site that is geographically separated from the primary site to enable the restoration of critical systems and resumption of business operations in case of disruption at the primary site.
json.ai_notes: Requirement for a geographically separated recovery site is explicit.

json.title: Develop annual IT audit plan
json.description: Create a comprehensive annual IT audit plan covering goals, schedules, resources, and reporting requirements.
json.full_text: An annual audit plan detailing IT audit's budgeting and planning processes including audit goals, schedules, staffing needs and reporting requirements.
json.ai_notes: Annual IT audit plan is explicitly required.

json.title: Define audit report format
json.description: Define and document the structure and content of audit reports to ensure they meet organizational and regulatory requirements.
json.full_text: Audit report format.
json.ai_notes: This control overlaps with the previous one but focuses on the definition process.

json.title: Maintain IT audit findings documentation
json.description: Ensure IT audit findings are documented, maintained, and retained in accordance with the defined policy.
json.full_text: Document maintenance and retention policy for IT findings.
json.ai_notes: This control focuses on the operational aspect of maintaining documentation.

json.title: Follow-up processes for significant IT audit findings
json.description: Ensure compliance with follow-up processes for addressing significant IT audit findings.
json.full_text: Follow-up processes for significant IT audit findings.
json.ai_notes: Similar to the previous control but with a compliance focus.

json.title: Identify weaknesses and review management's plans
json.description: Identify control weaknesses, recommend improvements, and evaluate management's remediation plans.
json.full_text: Identification of weaknesses, providing meaningful recommendations and reviewing management's plans for addressing those weaknesses.
json.ai_notes: Focuses on risk identification and management review.

json.title: Review adequacy of general controls
json.description: Assess the adequacy of general IT controls across various operational and strategic areas.
json.full_text: Reviewing the adequacy of general controls in place covering areas such as IT strategic & business planning, IT operations, DR/BCP, IT outsourcing, information security, development and acquisitions, ADCs, IT Procurements and Project Management.
